thread:
devin: Quick check — where are we on the token-cost attribution rollout? owners, blockers, and a rough canary timeline? PR links appreciated.

anita: I'm the primary owner for attribution pipeline. aiming for a canary Fri EOD (US-PST). blockers: event schema v2 and a small runtime header change from eng-runtime.

maria: PR for schema v2 is up: https://git.redwood/infra/evt-schema/pulls/4581 — it adds cost_bucket and latency_breakdown fields. Needs eng-platform + eng-ml review.

sanjay: Runtime change is tiny (x-kv-prefix header handling). patch in https://git.redwood/serving/pulls/4599. Without it KV-prefetch fails for batched warmups, which skews latency attribution.

luca: Infra note — Dedicated canary needs reserved slots Wed/Thu to run perf runs. @eng-infra can we get a small pool provisioned? cc: @eng-sre

tia: I can run the smoke scenarios and the eval prompt set. Which dataset should I use? small prod sampling or synthetic?

devin: use small prod-ish subset (anita uploaded a scrubbed slice here: https://redwood.share/attribution/slices/trimmed-2026-03-10). aim for ~10k requests for the smoke run.

anita: checklist I'm tracking:
- evt-schema v2 PR merged (#4581)
- runtime header patch merged (#4599)
- infra pool provisioned for canary (luca)
- canary run + perf dashboards (tia)
- post-canary A/B metrics gating + rollback plan

maria: schema diff (snippet):
```
{
  "event_name": "inference.response",
  "tokens": 120,
  "cost": 0.0045,
  "cost_bucket": "mid",
  "latency_breakdown": {"encode": 12, "decode": 85, "queue": 5}
}
```
Note: cost_bucket is derived field; ingestion needs to store raw cost and token_count.

sanjay: CI for runtime patch is green but we still need perf baseline. `ci-bot` reported: build passed on 4599 :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: build #4599 — all checks passed (unit, integration). Perf tests pending.

luca: infra can provision 4xV100 nodes for Thu morning window. I'll add them to the canary pool and tag resources with `attribution-canary-214365`.

tia: I'll start smoke runs Thu 09:00 PST. plan: 3 bursts (1k, 3k, 6k) and compare latency_breakdown distributions + token-cost deltas. Posting results to the canary dashboard.

devin: PR review pings: @maria please review schema, @sanjay please merge runtime after perf baseline. @anita please confirm rollback steps in the console.

anita: Rollback plan: auto-fallback to model-variant `v1-cost` via routing policy + immediate disable of attribution ingestion pipeline. document here: https://redwood.docs/attribution/rollback. I'll also add a one-click toggle in the console.

maria: Reviewed schema comments, made two minor changes re: optional fields and nullability. pushed fix to 4581. please re-run CI.

sanjay: merging runtime after perf run. leaving a short window for hotfixes.

devin: thanks all. I'll summarize this and create the cross-team weekly ticket with owners + dates. Action items captured in the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/ENG-AT-2026

anita: thanks — will update the ticket once schema and runtime are merged. :thumbsup:
